column1: # Lines of the operator, full-stack, gateway and node suites that name a
# release target on purpose, read by test-pr-install.sh. Each entry is the
# script's path and the line's text with its leading blanks dropped, separated
# by one tab, so an entry follows its line when lines move and goes stale when
# the line changes. A row clears one line, so a text kept on three lines of a
# file has three rows. Lines starting with # and blank lines are skipped. No
# line needs one: every suite drives the PR install, its gateway included.
